title: Token Econ Workbench — cache & batching hypotheses
summary: Working spreadsheet and hypothesis log that combines per-model per-region COGS, amortization of GPU infra, KV-prefix cache sizing, and batching/latency tradeoffs. Purpose: produce a prioritized list of low-friction config changes and experiments that materially improve hosted API unit margins without degrading p95 latency beyond current SLOs.
key_assumptions: GPU amortization: $1.50/hour effective for a mixed A100/H100 pool (weighted avg) when fully utilized
Network egress: US regions $0.02/GB, EU regions $0.035/GB (applied to embeddings and long-context states)
Storage for KV cache: $0.10/GB-month for hot cache (in-region SSD-backed), provisioned per-customer cache shards
Baseline avg request: 380 input tokens, 120 output tokens (chat workload sample), 0.5% long-run runaway sessions
Baseline batching behavior: 1.8k concurrent async requests -> average batch size 14 for 8k context models, p50 token latency measured at 70ms
Cache hit elasticity: small prefix cache targeted at 25% of requests (system prompts, common boilerplate) with 60% average per-request token hit reduction when hit
Model quantization/variant multipliers: 4-bit variants reduce GPU token cost ~35% vs fp16 for the same latencies, but increase CPU prep time by ~12%
Currency/Country multipliers: EU regulatory/telecom fees add ~8–12% to regional COGS for hosted customers
SLA targets: p95 latency < 500ms for conversational endpoints in premium tier; < 1s for standard tier
quick_metrics_snapshot: Baseline (US-West hosted): small-gen model (gpt-lite-13b-q4) COGS ~ $0.00035/token; medium-gen model (llama-70b-q4fm) COGS ~ $0.0014/token; embedding vector COGS ~ $0.00009/vector. Estimated blended per-API-call COGS for avg chat session (380 in / 120 out) = $0.185 (no cache). Blended gross margin at current hosted list pricing = 58% (hosted rate assumptions in 'Input Assumptions' tab).
cache_scenarios_tested: Micro-prefix cache (hot 5% of unique prefixes): 25% request hit rate, avg token reduction 60% when hit -> net token saving 15%
Session KV caching (per-session last-2048 tokens): benefits long-running sessions; effective on 8% of calls, reduces token regen by avg 42%
Global template cache (system prompts & onboarding copy): low memory, high hit for PLG funnels -> 8% global savings
Edge-proxied cache (regional): reduces egress & cross-region routing for EU customers; cost trade: additional regional SSD but lowers egress by estimated $0.01/GB
batching_scenarios_tested: Aggressive batching (target batch size 32): improves throughput and token amortization but increases median token latency +20ms and p95 tail risk if concurrency spikes
Dynamic latency-aware batching: cap batch assemble time to 10ms for premium endpoints, allowed 30ms for standard endpoints
Hybrid: small models batched aggressively; large models (70B+) kept at conservative batch sizes to protect p95
high_level_recs: Ship prefix-keyed caching for PLG funnel endpoints as a low-risk default (expected ~12–18% token saving on onboarding flows). Owner: Diego.
Introduce regional cache shards for EU (pilot) to cut egress and reduce EU-hosted COGS by ~6–9% for embedding-heavy customers. Owner: Priya.

Add model-variant routing policy: prefer int4/quantized variants for standard tier when customer tolerance is within defined eval thresholds; expected token COGS reduction 25–40% depending on model. Owner: Product/Model Onboarding.
Enable latency-aware batching config in Console with recommended presets (premium/standard/low-cost) so customers can tune margin vs latency without ops intervention. Owner: Console team.
Run a 4-week A/B test on 3 high-volume customers to validate session-KV cache: measure per-session token reduction, latency impact, and operational memory footprint. Owner: Solutions Eng.
Quick win: set default small-model batching target +5 to increase effective utilization during low-traffic hours (expected 3–6% COGS reduction at cluster-level). Owner: SRE/Infra
estimated_impact_table_notes: Impact figures are model-weighted, blended across observed traffic mix in Q4 2025. Individual customer impact will vary with prompt length distribution and chat vs embedding mix.
Measurements exclude cost-of-sales and support; only infra COGS and direct network/storage expenses included.
Risk buckets: operational memory spike (cache), p95 tail regression (batching), customer-perceived quality drop (quant variants).
